results.actual: A newly created order displayed “Chờ xác nhận” with the pending badge style.
The API accepted the valid sequence confirmed → shipping → delivered.
The cancellation request returned HTTP 200; the shipping order became canceled.
results.notes: Shipping is incorrectly treated as cancelable.

results.actual: Canceled → delivered returned HTTP 200; the admin UI displayed the resulting delivered state.
results.notes: A terminal canceled order can escape to delivered.

results.actual: SAVE10 (10%) reported savings of -270,000,000 ₫ and a final total of 300,000,000 ₫; the correct values are 3,000,000 ₫ and 27,000,000 ₫.
results.notes: Percentage discount calculation is incorrect.

results.actual: The invalid coupon displayed the inline message “Mã giảm giá không tồn tại hoặc đã bị vô hiệu hóa”.
Checkout displayed a dedicated success state and provided navigation back to the home page.
A delivered order rejected a transition back to confirmed with HTTP 400.
Order history rendered as a structured five-column table at 1440×1000.
Status badges rendered localized labels: Đã hủy, Đã giao, Chờ xác nhận, Chờ xác nhận.
The valid Vietnamese number 0912345678 was rejected with “Số điện thoại không hợp lệ. Vui lòng nhập đúng 9-10 chữ số.”.
results.notes: The regex disallows the required leading zero.

Order-history rows provide no expansion control, details link, or item-level view.
results.notes: The interface exposes only summary columns.
